scheme_name: Scheme of Pension for Eminent Sports Persons
description:
The Scheme of Pension for Eminent Sports Persons was launched by the Government of India in 2006. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eminent sportspersons who have made significant contributions to Indian sports. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to recognize and reward the achievements of sports persons at the national and international levels. 

The scheme is designed to provide a monthly pension to eligible sportspersons to ensure their financial security after retirement from active sports. 

The pension amount under this scheme is set at ₹20,000 per month. 

This pension is provided to sportspersons who have excelled in their respective sports and have contributed to the promotion of sports in India. 

To be eligible for this pension scheme, sportspersons must have achieved a minimum of one of the following criteria. 

They must have won a medal in the Olympic Games. 

Alternatively, they must have secured a medal in the World Championships or the Commonwealth Games. 

Sportspersons who have received the Arjuna Award or the Dronacharya Award are also eligible for this pension. 

The eligibility criteria also include sportspersons who have been awarded the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award. 

The scheme is open to sportspersons from various disciplines including athletics, cricket, hockey, badminton, and wrestling among others. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

Eligible sportspersons must submit their applications to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

The application must include proof of eligibility such as copies of medals or awards received. 

Sportspersons are also required to submit a self-attested copy of their identity proof. 

Additionally, they must provide their bank account details for the disbursement of the pension. 

The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports reviews the applications and verifies the eligibility of the applicants. 

Once approved, the pension is disbursed on a monthly basis. 

The pension is credited directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Sports under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

The contact details for the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports are available on their official website. 

The scheme has been beneficial for many eminent sportspersons who have contributed to Indian sports. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has provided financial assistance to over 300 sportspersons. 

The pension helps these individuals maintain a decent standard of living after their sports careers. 

The scheme also aims to encourage young athletes by recognizing the contributions of their predecessors. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹10 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This budget is intended to cover the pensions of eligible sportspersons and ensure timely disbursement. 

The scheme is reviewed periodically to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account to improve the scheme. 

The government aims to expand the scheme to include more sportspersons in the future. 

The pension scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote sports in India. 

It aligns with the government's vision of making India a sporting nation. 

The scheme also contributes to the overall development of sports infrastructure in the country. 

In addition to the pension, the government also provides various other support measures for sportspersons. 

These include training facilities, coaching programs, and financial assistance for participation in competitions. 

The government is committed to ensuring that sportspersons receive the recognition and support they deserve. 

The Scheme of Pension for Eminent Sports Persons is a vital step in this direction. 

It acknowledges the hard work and dedication of athletes who have brought glory to the nation. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of sportspersons. 

It reflects the importance of sports in fostering national pride and unity. 

The pension scheme is expected to motivate more individuals to pursue sports as a career. 

It serves as a safety net for those who have dedicated their lives to the field of sports. 

The government is continuously working to enhance the scope of this scheme. 

It aims to ensure that more deserving sportspersons benefit from the financial assistance provided. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who appreciate the financial support. 

Many sportspersons have expressed gratitude for the recognition of their contributions. 

The pension scheme is a significant milestone in the journey of sports development in India. 

It plays a crucial role in ensuring that sportspersons are not forgotten after their active years. 

The government remains focused on improving the lives of those who have excelled in sports. 

The Scheme of Pension for Eminent Sports Persons is an essential part of this initiative. 

Overall, the scheme is a comprehensive effort to support and honor the achievements of eminent sportspersons in India. 

It is a clear indication of the government's commitment to promoting sports and ensuring the welfare of athletes. 

The scheme continues to evolve and adapt to the changing needs of sportspersons in the country. 

It stands as a model for similar initiatives aimed at supporting athletes across various disciplines. 

The pension scheme is a vital resource for many former athletes who have dedicated their lives to sports. 

It provides them with the financial stability they need to lead fulfilling lives post-retirement. 

The government is dedicated to ensuring that this scheme remains effective and beneficial for all eligible sportspersons. 

The Scheme of Pension for Eminent Sports Persons is a crucial component of India's sports policy. 

It reflects the nation's respect and appreciation for the contributions of its athletes. 

This scheme is expected to continue making a positive impact on the lives of sportspersons for years to come.
